description: Team-by-team match statistics for one event — shots on goal, corners, possession, fouls, passes and whatever else the source recorded, as home/away pairs. Use for settling shot-count, corner and possession questions. COVERAGE IS PER-COMPETITION: a match the source has not covered returns found:false with a reason, not an error.

_apiKey.description: Optional TheSportsDB key. The free tier serves this tool; a supporter key raises the rate limit.
